text:
maria: quick Q — where's the best saved-search for EU gen routes 5xx + kv-cache-misses? trying to tune alerts for acme org
jonathan: there's a query we used last month, lemme paste it. it's not saved with a great name tho
jonathan: ```scope:logs source:inference region:eu org:acme route:gen* status:[500 TO 599] | stats count() as errors, pct(kv_miss) as kv_miss_pct by model, route | sort -errors```
jonathan: you can filter further for model=zenith-gen if you want narrower
neha: tagging — i made a cleaned up saved view earlier: https://logs.redwood.com/saved/ops-eu-acme-5xx-kvmiss (id: ss-9876)
neha: saved name: ops/eu-gen/acme-5xx-kvmiss — follows the ops/<region>/<workload>/<short-desc> convention
maria: perfect, thanks! can you also add p95 latency and kv miss rate to the same view?
neha: done. I added columns: p95_latency_ms, kv_miss_pct. Query attached to the saved view now returns those fields
sre-bot: alert suggestion: "eu.acme.gen.5xx_kvmiss" -> trigger when 5xx_rate > 0.5% AND kv_miss_pct > 3% for 5m
sre-bot: example alert rule payload:
```
name: eu.acme.gen.5xx_kvmiss
query: scope:logs region:eu org:acme route:gen* | stats pct(status>=500) as five_xx, pct(kv_miss) as kv_miss_pct by 1m
condition: five_xx > 0.5 AND kv_miss_pct > 3
window: 5m
severity: P2
notify: #oncall-ops
```
alex: fyi i've added the saved view link to the EU-gen runbook under Observability -> Saved Views and linked the alert to the oncall rota
alex: if people want to tweak thresholds, propose values here and i'll update the alert policy
maria: maybe lower kv_miss threshold to 2% for canary orgs, but keep 3% for prod acme
athan: (not in the thread but pinging) jonathan can you confirm the query works with large time ranges? we had a scan issue last quarter
jonathan: it paginates fine but recommend limiting to 1h for ad-hoc dashboards, saved view uses pre-aggregated index so it's fine for 24h
neha: added note in saved view description: "Use short time window for live hunts; dashboard uses 24h preagg for alerts"
maria: awesome. can someone pin this saved view to the ops dashboard and set it as a shortcut in the #eng-sre sidebar?
alex: pinned to Ops Overview dashboard and added shortcut. closing the loop — thanks all :thumbsup:
